clips.title: The story
paras: At Mist's Edge, a giant sea thresher lies stranded while murlocs feed on its carcass. In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers samples for night elf researchers in Darnassus, who seek to learn why deep-sea giants are washing ashore.

Enormous thresher remains have appeared along Mist's Edge, where shipwrecks and tide-washed debris are familiar sights. This beast dwarfs the wildlife of Darkshore's shallows, suggesting it came from far beyond the calm waters of the Veiled Sea. Murlocs swarm over the corpse to feed, but they lack the strength and coordination to bring down a creature of this size. Something else killed the predator before the sea carried it ashore.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde coordinates efforts in Auberdine to salvage bones and biological samples from Darkshore's stranded sea giants. Night elf researchers in Darnassus hope the remains will show whether illness, disturbances in the deep sea, or arcane corruption drives the giants onto the killing sands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in Darkshore - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge. How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast.
While some of it has been picked clean, enough of it remains to take a sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine to study.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore. Until then, we must continue our research!
Greetings friend - what news do you bring?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another discovery - well done friend! These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus. Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
